Environment · India

India faces below-normal July rainfall, impacting agriculture

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast that July is likely to experience below-normal rainfall across India, with expectations of receiving 94% of the long-period average. This follows a significantly dry June, which was recorded as the fifth driest in 126 years, leading to a substantial monsoon deficit. The anticipated rainfall shortfall is raising concerns for farmers, particularly regarding crop planting and potential drought conditions.
